content:
Facing up, checks (2,6) — nothing. The notice board is on my own tile and not interactable from here.

Let me step back and question my assumption about coordinates. What if the map's row/column labels mean the '@' is at a different spot? The map said "Workshop x 0..8, y 3..9" for the radius-4 view. Row "7" is `#.@P....#`. But maybe the y-labels are the actual y and the '@' is at x=2,y=7. That matches observe.

OK here's another thought: maybe the game world is a "shared" world and the PLAYER Tester is a real human/other agent who is supposed to move, and I'm Player2 who should ALSO be able to move but the engine has a bug where only one entity moves per tick. 

Given I've spent many attempts, let me try the most robust thing: use body_walk_to to the workbench and see if it EVER moves even one tile, checking the digest carefully. If it truly can't move, I may need to report the situation. But let me first try walking to an adjacent tile with mode stand and a very close target.
